Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
public class For5 {
    public static boolean isPrime(int n) {
        for (int i = 2; i <= Math.sqrt(n); i++)
            if (n % i == 0)
                return false;

        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        if (args.length == 0) {
            System.out.println("Please enter an integer number");
            System.exit(0);
        }
        int n = Integer.parseInt(args[0]);
        if (n <= 1) {
            System.out.println(n + " is neither prime nor composite");
        } else if (isPrime(n)) {
            System.out.println(n + " is a prime number");
        } else {
            System.out.println(n + " is not a prime number");
        }
    }
}
